main.description: Main source file to compile (.p8 or .pb)

target.description: Target platform for compilation. Use a built-in target name (cx16, c64, c128, pet32, virtual) or a path to a custom target .properties file (e.g., './nes.properties' or 'targets/custom.properties'). When using a custom target, the built-in library symbols (syslib, etc.) are not available.

oneOf.description: Path to a custom target .properties file (relative to project directory or absolute)

outputDir.description: Output directory for compiled files (relative to project folder)

launchEmu.description: Launch emulator after successful compilation (uses compiler -emu flag)

run.description: Custom script or executable to run after compilation (alternative to launchEmu). Environment variables PRG_PATH and PROJECT_DIR will be set.

passMainToScript.description: Whether to pass the main file path as an argument to the custom script. If true (default), script receives main file as first argument. If false, script runs without file argument and must determine what to compile on its own.

compilationMode.description: How to compile the project: auto (detect from settings), standard (use prog8c + 64tass), or custom-script (use 'run' script for everything)
enumDescriptions: Use custom script specified in 'run' for complete build process

compilerPath.description: Path to prog8c compiler (executable or .jar file). Overrides extension setting.

javaPath.description: Path to Java executable (only needed if compiler is a .jar file). Overrides extension setting.

assemblerFolder.description: Folder containing the 64tass assembler binary (required by compiler). Overrides extension setting.

emulatorFolder.description: Folder containing emulators (x16emu, x64sc, x128, xpet). Overrides extension setting.

srcdirs.description: Additional directories where the compiler can look for imported modules. Can be absolute or relative paths. For standard mode (binary/jar), passed as -srcdirs flag. For custom-script mode, set as PROG8_SRCDIRS environment variable.

compilerArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to the compiler or custom script. For standard mode, these are inserted before the main file argument. For custom-script mode, these are passed as additional arguments to the script.

keywordCasing.description: Automatically format ProgB keywords to the specified casing style
enumDescriptions: Camel Case - End If, Module, Dim

formatCommaSpacing.description: Automatically add a space after commas in ProgB code
